notes: A good antioxidant support layer under SPF.

benefits.mechanism: Green tea polyphenols, chiefly EGCG, scavenge reactive oxygen species generated by UV and pollution, limiting oxidative stress at the skin surface.
benefits.what_it_means: Adds antioxidant defense against daily UV and pollution exposure and supports a fresher, more even look.

benefits.mechanism: Its polyphenol antioxidants reduce oxidative triggers that contribute to a flushed appearance.
benefits.what_it_means: Helps calm the look of redness-prone, reactive skin.

evidence.summary: Polyphenol antioxidant (EGCG) activity is an established cosmetic function of green tea extract; graded C (ingredient function).

overview: Green tea extract supplies polyphenol antioxidants that help defend skin against daily environmental oxidative stress and calm the look of redness-prone skin.

ingredient.what_it_is: An extract of the green tea leaf rich in polyphenol antioxidants (notably EGCG), used to add antioxidant defense and calm the look of stressed skin.

marketing_vs_reality.reality: Skin does not "detox"; green tea provides genuine antioxidant polyphenols that help defend against daily oxidative stress — a protective, not a detoxifying, role.
